halls.title: Character LCD
halls.about: Sixteen columns of 5×8 dot cells and eight characters a face can redraw. The liquid crystal takes about 150 ms to switch, so anything that moves leaves a ghost.

faces.name: Miner
faces.blurb: prototype

faces.name: Samurai
faces.blurb: Placeholder.

faces.name: Zipper
faces.blurb: The numerals are zippers; each minute the slider unzips the digit that changes and zips up the new one, and on the hour it snags.

faces.name: Searchlight
faces.blurb: Glow paint on a prison wall, charged by a sweeping searchlight; a burglar repaints the minute between sweeps and freezes as paint when it finds him.

faces.name: angler
faces.blurb: Placeholder.

faces.name: towercrane
faces.blurb: wip

faces.name: Busker
faces.blurb: A street juggler keeps the four digits in the air; each minute he tosses the old one away and a kid in the crowd lobs him the new one.

faces.name: pigeons
faces.blurb: Placeholder.

faces.name: Slots
faces.blurb: A pachislot machine whose reels land on the time; a cat pulls the lever every minute, and on the hour it hits the jackpot.

faces.name: Sokoban
faces.blurb: The time is a Sokoban level built of crates; every minute a tiny warehouse keeper pushes the old digits into the new ones.

faces.name: Snake
faces.blurb: Four snakes curled up into the time. Each minute an apple appears and the last digit uncoils, eats it, wraps round the glass and coils into the next.

faces.name: Whack-a-Clock
faces.blurb: Moles peek over the digits; each minute the mallet whacks the one that changed into its hole and a new mole pushes up the new digit.

faces.name: Hamster
faces.blurb: An odometer whose last drum is a hamster wheel: he sprints for every carry, and the hour's ripple flings him over the top.

faces.name: Domino
faces.blurb: The time as two double-nine dominoes; a glove re-stands a domino run all minute, flicks it, and the struck tile turns over.

faces.name: Matchstick
faces.blurb: A matchstick puzzle that solves itself: each minute a matchstick man moves the fewest matches to make the new time; on the hour he sets the old one alight.

faces.name: Snail
faces.blurb: A snail-powered marble run: its slime trail along the path is the minutes; each hour it rolls home to a shelf of sleeping shells, one per hour.

faces.name: Printer
faces.blurb: A print head with a face lives between the hours and minutes; each minute the tractor paper feeds and it hammers out the new time.

faces.name: Goods
faces.blurb: A steam train carries the time as freight; a goods crane swaps the minutes at every station, and on the hour a new train backs in.

faces.name: Lion dance
faces.blurb: A lion dances to the drum, eats the minute ball each minute and spits out the next; on the hour firecrackers knock the lanterns down.

faces.name: Tug of War
faces.blurb: The hours and the minutes, digits with arms and legs, in a tug of war over a mud pit; each minute the loser is flung into the mud.

faces.name: Classic
faces.blurb: Stock ROM font, centred HH:MM:SS. The baseline every other design is measured against.

faces.name: Monolith
faces.blurb: A five-by-sixteen typeface spanning both rows; digits roll like a counter; ROM colon and seconds bar.

faces.name: Aurora
faces.blurb: Stock-ROM time over a heart-monitor sweep, one beat a second, redrawn every frame from one CGRAM page.

faces.name: Flipclock
faces.blurb: Bold 5x7 digits that flip like split-flap cards: top half first, then the bottom.

faces.name: Ember
faces.blurb: A bold ten-by-eight geometric face on amber, with stock-ROM seconds.

faces.name: Clone
faces.blurb: A very heavy 10x8 face on amber with the date beneath: the half-height take on the reference photo (slab is the full one).

faces.name: Focus
faces.blurb: The minutes as two huge drawn digits (four tiles each, all eight), the rest spelled out: MIN PAST 10, AND 37 SEC.

faces.name: Slab
faces.blurb: The reference photo, dot for dot: four 3x2-cell block digits, ROM colon, squared seconds.

faces.name: Tide
faces.blurb: Kit-of-parts digits that fill with rippling water over each minute and drain as it turns.

faces.name: Hourglass
faces.blurb: Full-height kit-of-parts digits beside a 10x16 sand glass that drains each minute and flips.

faces.name: Stack
faces.blurb: The block face, cleared and rebuilt piece by falling piece whenever a digit turns.

faces.name: Dial
faces.blurb: An analog dial drawn at the real dot positions, with an orbiting seconds dot; the date in ROM.

faces.name: Cipher
faces.blurb: Bold time digits that decode through ROM katakana as they change; a date that decrypts once a minute.

faces.name: Pong
faces.blurb: The score is the time: the hours player misses every minute, the minutes player every hour.

faces.name: Chomp
faces.blurb: Block digits with power-pellet colon; every minute Pac-Man eats the old time and leaves the new.

faces.name: Carousel
faces.blurb: Two faces on the 40-cell DDRAM ring; each minute the controller's own display shift pulls the next one in.

faces.name: Typist
faces.blurb: The time in words, typed live: each minute a cursor backspaces over what changed and types the new words.

faces.name: Phantom
faces.blurb: A 12-hour seven-segment LCD with the unlit segments ghosting behind the time, in a grey the hardware does not have.

faces.name: Invaders
faces.blurb: The digits march like invaders; each minute the cannon shoots the one that changed and the new one beams in.

faces.name: Warp
faces.blurb: Tall digits at the bridge window, ROM stars streaming past faster through the minute, a jump to lightspeed at :00.

faces.name: Telegraph
faces.blurb: Sends itself the time in Morse at :00 and the date at :30, on a scrolling paper tape, and prints what it receives.

faces.name: Cuckoo
faces.blurb: A chalet with a working dial and swinging pendulum; on the hour the bird slides out and calls the hour, a dot per call.

faces.name: Soroban
faces.blurb: The time set on a soroban, a heaven bead and four earth beads per rod, sliding when the minute turns.

faces.name: Frog
faces.blurb: A frog in glasses catches a fly every minute, hops on the hour, and sleeps at night with z's drifting up.

faces.name: Claude
faces.blurb: The Claude spark thinking in waves beside the CLI spinner and a whimsical verb; at each minute it bursts and says what it did.

faces.name: Aquarium
faces.blurb: Two fish swim round the whole glass, through the clock; the big one changes each digit as it swims past at :00.

faces.name: Chat
faces.blurb: A robot and a ghost at either end of the glass, chatting about the time; at :00 they turn and shout the new minute.

faces.name: Runner
faces.blurb: The offline dinosaur game across the glass: cacti to jump, a pterodactyl to duck each minute, GAME OVER on the hour.

faces.name: Garden
faces.blurb: A flower that sprouts at midnight, blooms by noon and goes to seed at night, under a sun that is the hour hand.

faces.name: Cat
faces.blurb: A black cat asleep beside the clock: it breathes, twitches, watches a mouse, and on the hour wakes, stretches and meows the hour.

faces.name: Flashcard
faces.blurb: One custom character, 32 copies: the glass flashes each digit of the time in turn, minutes underlined.

faces.name: Wallpaper
faces.blurb: A 5x8 BCD clock tiled 32 times into a woven pattern; a ticking cursor walks the cells as the seconds.

faces.name: Beads
faces.blurb: Two wires of beads, two custom characters: the hour and the fives of minutes, the cursor for the rest.

faces.name: Tally
faces.blurb: Hours and minutes scratched on a stone wall in 正 tally marks, four slots and no factory character; each new mark is scratched in.

faces.name: Pure
faces.blurb: Block digits in the rain with no factory character on the glass; on the minute the whole screen goes negative.

faces.name: Full house
faces.blurb: HH:MM:SS with no factory characters: all eight slots, the blank's dots ticking the seconds across the whole glass.

faces.name: Solo
faces.blurb: One numeral, the hour, stands in the sea; the tide rising up it is the seconds, a boat sailing past is the minutes.

faces.name: Candle
faces.blurb: Portrait. A candle burns a dot a minute through the hour, dripping wax; on the hour it goes out and a fresh one is lit.

faces.name: Rocket
faces.blurb: Portrait. A rocket climbs the glass through the hour past streaming ROM stars, stages at :30, and a new one launches on the hour.

faces.name: Totem
faces.blurb: Portrait: HH over MM, four digits the full width of the glass, stacked like a totem pole; they roll like an odometer.

faces.name: Thermometer
faces.blurb: Portrait: a mercury thermometer that rises a dot a minute; the seams are the scale, the seconds a heartbeat.

faces.name: Sixteen
faces.blurb: Four drawn 10x16 digits, sixteen tiles, by alternating two CGRAM pages: repeated digits full, the rest at half contrast.

faces.name: Greyfrog
faces.blurb: The rainbow frog with a grey body: two CGRAM pages alternated, so the fill is a half-tone third tone behind full-contrast lines.

faces.name: Glide
faces.blurb: A sweep-seconds hand that glides between dots: the slow glass averages four alternating frames into sub-dot positions.

faces.name: Calibrate
faces.blurb: A bench test card: grey patches made by alternating frames, and flicker tests, to compare the simulator with real glass.

faces.name: Abacus
faces.blurb: The time as beads on a soroban: four rods of five-by-sixteen dots, the beads sliding to the new number each minute.

faces.name: Morse
faces.blurb: A beacon keying the time in Morse: a lamp flashing dot and dash, and a tape that scrolls as it is written.

faces.name: Moon
faces.blurb: Tonight's real Moon, drawn at its true phase with a terminator ellipse, stars twinkling and earthshine on the dark limb.

faces.name: Strike
faces.blurb: A long-case clock: the block face split by a window with a seconds pendulum in it, which rings the hour.

faces.name: Cradle
faces.blurb: A Newton's cradle: pulled, released, click-clack, and slowly still again.

faces.name: Lava lamp
faces.blurb: Portrait. A lava lamp: wax buds from the pool, pinches off, rises, cools under the cap and sinks back.

faces.name: Ducks
faces.blurb: A mother duck and her ducklings: in along the bank, onto the pond, one dawdles, one dives, one strays; at night they sleep in a huddle.

faces.name: Orrery
faces.blurb: The solar system at a tilt: Kepler periods, transits, a moon, and a comet every few minutes.

faces.name: Fireflies
faces.blurb: Dusk in a meadow: fireflies drift, fall into step, and a frog in glasses waits.

faces.name: DVD
faces.blurb: The bouncing screensaver logo. It nearly hits the corner, and every 112.5 s it really does.

halls.title: Monochrome OLED
halls.about: Every pixel makes its own light, one colour per panel, on glass that is black when off. Pixels left lit for hours burn in, so most faces keep moving.

faces.name: String Art
faces.blurb: Placeholder.

faces.name: X-Ray
faces.blurb: An airport baggage scanner seen through its side: the minutes are packed in the bag on the belt, numerals built from umbrellas, hair dryers and handcuffs that only show once the bag crosses the beam; the hour is laid out on the inspection table, and an alarm repacks it.

faces.name: ropeknot
faces.blurb: Placeholder.

faces.name: Quincunx
faces.blurb: Placeholder.

faces.name: Cootie
faces.blurb: Prototype.

faces.name: Labyrinth
faces.blurb: A wooden tilt maze whose rails are the time: a ghost player steers a steel ball round the numerals, sinks it at the minute, and the rails of the old digit sink as the new ones rise.

faces.name: Plasticine
faces.blurb: Placeholder.

faces.name: Tippe Tops
faces.blurb: Two tippe tops on a turned tray carry the time on their balls: each lives as long as its number, wobbling wider as it slows, falls on its side and rolls away, and the next is dropped ball-down and flips itself over to show the new number.

faces.name: Kinetic Rain
faces.blurb: A field of 1,972 droplets on wires seen from below: the time hangs in it as rain-trail numerals; a curtain of rain sweeps the minute, and the hour swirls round the field like water down a drain.

faces.name: Trivision
faces.blurb: A roadside prism billboard in real 3D: on the minute its slats turn in a wave to the next poster; on the hour the board spins round on its pole.

faces.name: Twister
faces.blurb: The time twisted out of long balloons in real 3D: the minutes hop and bonk on the floor, the hours float on ribbons; each minute a balloon lets its twists go, springs into a coil and is twisted bubble by bubble into the next; on the hour the old hours fizz off round the room and a bunch of party balloons carries in the new.

faces.name: Ribbon
faces.blurb: A gymnast's ribbon writes the time in 3D: twists run down it, on the minute it whips into a corkscrew and re-lays the numeral, on the hour it coils across the glass.

faces.name: Ouroboros
faces.blurb: Every numeral is a living serpent: an ouroboros dial whose head sweeps the seconds round the hour, two adders coiled into the minutes; each minute the changed one slithers into the next, and on the hour they all shed their skins.

faces.name: Glory Hole
faces.blurb: A glass studio at night: each numeral is a thread of hot glass pulled up from its own molten foot, glowing as new as it is; on the minute it slumps back into a gob and the jacks pull the next one out of it; on the hour the furnace door is thrown open and a gather pours the new hour.

faces.name: Cloud Chamber
faces.blurb: A cloud chamber in a magnetic field: numerals made of particle events (decay kinks, pair forks, spiralling electrons) rewritten by their own tracks every few seconds; each minute the old one boils into mist that eddies onto the new, and on the hour a nuclear star bursts across the chamber.

faces.name: Mobile
faces.blurb: A Calder mobile of carved blocks: each is cut so it reads as this minute face on and as the next one side on; the thread winds, the block turns a quarter turn and the arms find a new balance. On the hour a gust.

round.label: Round 11
round.note: 8 opus faces, imaginative + fluent + designed letterforms

faces.name: Octopus
faces.blurb: An octopus in a rock pool writes the time with itself: its arms curl into the minutes, its skin spots the hour; each minute an arm lets go, waves at the fish and coils into the next, and on the hour it inks the pool and flushes a new hour.

round.label: Round 11
round.note: 8 opus faces, imaginative + fluent + designed letterforms

faces.name: Big Top
faces.blurb: A circus troupe performs the time: Cyr wheels, perch poles and contortionists are the numerals, the hours on a swinging trapeze; each minute the acrobats somersault into the new act, and on the hour a human cannonball is fired across the ring.

round.label: Round 11
round.note: 8 opus faces, imaginative + fluent + designed letterforms

faces.name: Popcorn
faces.blurb: The time is popcorn: the hour heaped up out of a hanging kettle between its rattling lid flaps, the minutes in big heaps on the floor; kernels keep popping under them, each minute the kettle tips and fresh kernels burst in the air and land as the new numeral, and on the hour the lid bangs open in a storm of popcorn.

round.label: Round 11
round.note: 8 opus faces, imaginative + fluent + designed letterforms

faces.name: Eight Ball
faces.blurb: A Magic 8-Ball: the time floats up on the die, cut in its own triangle; every minute the ball is shaken and the die rolls up the next answer.

round.label: Round 11
round.note: 8 opus faces, imaginative + fluent + designed letterforms

faces.name: Music Box
faces.blurb: The minutes pinned on the turning drum of a music box and plucked off its comb; each minute the pins slide to the new numeral, each hour the box whirls to a new air and strikes it.

round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Etch A Sketch
faces.blurb: An Etch A Sketch: two knobs draw the time as one line that never lifts; a tap shakes the changed numeral off as powder and the knobs redraw it; on the hour it is turned over and shaken clean.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Lemmings
faces.blurb: A Lemmings level: walkers march over brick minutes, a crew digs the old numeral out and lays its bricks as the new one; on the hour bombers blow up the rock hour and diggers carve the next.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Cat's Cradle
faces.blurb: The time is a string figure between two hands: a pinch lifts each minute off and it springs open anew; the hour is the whole cradle, turned over.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Waterfall
faces.blurb: A graphical water curtain held in a strobe: valves pour streams and drops into numerals; each minute the curtain lets go into the pool and the jets throw the next one up; a drip a second fills the bamboo that tips the hour.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Tangram
faces.blurb: Minutes cut from loose tangram pieces that re-solve themselves one hop at a time, the hour a printed puzzle card; a tangram cat pounces each minute and folds back into the solved square on the hour.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Marionette
faces.blurb: The time is a troupe of wooden marionettes: each minute the hand lets the old numeral slump into a heap of sticks and hauls the next one up out of it; on the hour the curtain falls and the troupe takes a bow.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Fogglass
faces.blurb: A fogged window at night: the time is wiped into the condensation by a fingertip, and the night shows sharp only through the trails; drops run, each minute a breath and a finger rewrite it, each hour a hand wipes the pane.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Bonsai
faces.blurb: A bonsai that grows the time: the minutes are wired branches in foliage pads that shed, bend and bud anew each minute while a clay monk sweeps up; the hour is deadwood, burnt in by lightning; the hour of day is the season.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Sparkler
faces.blurb: A kid writes the time in the air with a sparkler that burns down with the seconds; at the minute it lights a new one from the old numeral, which burns back into it like a fuse.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Soap Film
faces.blurb: The time in black film: minutes on a bubble wand, the hour on the bubble it blew; a puff of air swirls each minute into the next, and on the hour the wand blows a new bubble that pops the old.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Kaiten
faces.blurb: A sushi counter: the minutes are nigiri pressed into numerals, the hour a slice of decorated roll; the chef takes fresh fish off the belt and presses the next minute, and on the hour rolls a new slice in the mat while the belt races.

round.label: Round 10
round.note: 12 opus faces, concise brief, no critic

faces.name: Mandelbrot
faces.blurb: An endless spiral dive into the Mandelbrot set: distance-to-the-boundary bands dithered into 1-bit filigree, looping seamlessly.

round.note: pure animations — CPU "fragment shaders", no clock

faces.name: Attractor
faces.blurb: The Lorenz butterfly traced by one point of light: a glowing trail runs the eternal shape as the whole thing turns.

round.label: Round 9
round.note: pure animations — CPU "fragment shaders", no clock

faces.name: Flow
faces.blurb: A divergence-free curl-noise field: streamlines of ink that advect, braid and re-form forever.

round.note: pure animations — CPU "fragment shaders", no clock

faces.name: Nebula
faces.blurb: A volumetric raymarch: the camera drifts through an endless, self-shadowed cloud of glowing fog that churns as it streams past.

faces.name: Raymarch
faces.blurb: The time as four solid objects in a lit room: a real raymarched SDF scene, where the changing digit sinks into the stone and the new one extrudes back up out of it.

faces.name: Plasma
faces.blurb: Domain-warped plasma: the numerals are the bright level set of the boil, swelling with it and condensing out of it at every minute.

faces.name: Lumen
faces.blurb: The time as a living ball field: glowing charges bead along each digit and the iso-surface is the numeral — they undulate, merge, and flow from one minute into the next.

faces.name: Turing
faces.blurb: The time as a reef: each numeral is a trough of feed and the coral that grows in it is the time — the minute digit re-seeds and blooms.

faces.name: Soroban
faces.blurb: A soroban whose bead pattern is the time: beads click to the bar every minute and the whole rack is plucked on the hour.

faces.name: Slide Rule
faces.blurb: A slide rule set to the time: the stock and the slide are slipped a grade past each other every minute, and the cursor reads both scales at its hairline.

faces.name: Spiderweb
faces.blurb: The time spun into an orb web at dawn: silk numerals tied at knots and beaded with dew, a spider dangling as the colon, the seconds running the rim as a bead of dew.

faces.name: Dandelion
faces.blurb: The time combed out of dandelion fluff: hair-bundle numerals blown from the seed head, a breath of wind between one and the next, and a fresh head on the hour.

faces.name: Vault
faces.blurb: A bank vault door: the time is cut through its steel and lit from inside; four combination wheels turn it over, the time-lock dial between them sweeps the minute, and the bolts draw on the hour.

faces.name: Pinball
faces.blurb: A pinball playfield with a steel ball always in play: the time stands on it in banks of drop targets, and each minute a shot knocks the old numerals flat as it crosses them and the new ones swing up behind it.

faces.name: Clepsydra
faces.blurb: An ancient water clock in section: the numerals are channels cut in stone, and the time is the water running through them — a bead a second out of every cut, a spout dripping the colon, and at the hour a sheet that washes the new time down the wall.

faces.name: Cuckoo
faces.blurb: A Black Forest chalet by lamplight: the time is carved in relief into the case and re-cut every minute, the chains drag down a hairline a minute, and on the hour the doors fly open and the cuckoo calls.

faces.name: Press
faces.blurb: A letterpress forme: the time is lead type standing in the chase, the roller inks the new sorts as the minute turns, and on the hour the platen strikes.

faces.name: Turntable
faces.blurb: The time cut into the vinyl as ribbons of grooves; the record turns under a swinging sheen, and every minute the old numeral unbends into plain rings and the new one is cut.

faces.name: Constellation
faces.blurb: A star chart whose constellations are the time, joined by sight-lines: the changed figure re-lines itself star by star, the seconds are a satellite crossing the sky, and on the hour the whole sky turns a revolution in long exposure.

faces.name: Aurora
faces.blurb: The aurora borealis over a black ridge: the numerals are curtains of light whose raved veils hang in the sky, the seconds are a surge travelling the arc, the minutes re-hang the changed veil and the hour draws the whole sky up into a corona.

faces.name: Goban
faces.blurb: A go board: white stones spell the minutes, black stones the hour, a stone walks the board rim at one lap a minute, and each minute the old digit is captured off the board as the new one is clicked down.

faces.name: Morse
faces.blurb: A telegraph register: the time is punched through a backlit tape in dots and dashes — each numeral drawn in its own Morse rhythm — while the key taps the seconds and the sounder clacks.

faces.name: Honeycomb
faces.blurb: A tongue of comb across the dark of a hive: the hours sealed small under wax at its top, the minutes wet and larger at its foot, and a forager walking between them.

faces.name: Zen
faces.blurb: Rings raked around the stones that are the colon; the hours small and combed coarse above them, the minutes larger and combed fine below.

faces.name: Fireworks
faces.blurb: A harbour at night: the minutes are numeral shells hanging in the sky, the hour burns as a lance set-piece on the breakwater, and a fuse crawls the quay as the seconds; on the hour, a waterfall.

faces.name: Ferris
faces.blurb: A night fair: the wheel turns once a minute and its lit carriage carries the minutes, re-lettered in bulbs each time it comes down to the platform; the hour burns in bulbs over the gate.

faces.name: Siderod
faces.blurb: A night shunter, side on: the time is the engine's own number plates, the exhaust beats the seconds, and each minute the changed numeral is blown off the metal and poured back on.

faces.name: Thrown
faces.blurb: The time pressed into wet clay on a spinning wheel: the digits are ridges read by the light, smoothed flat and pressed again every minute, and the pot is re-thrown on the hour.

faces.name: Melde
faces.blurb: Four wires bent into numerals, singing on a shaker rail.

faces.name: Sampler
faces.blurb: A clockwork mouse bastes the hem a stitch a second; minutes are satin-stitched, hours cross-stitched.

faces.name: Monochord
faces.blurb: The time strung as taut wires in the exact shape of the digits; a standing wave runs along every wire, and the minute turn plucks and re-shapes the four that change into the next numeral.

faces.name: Wire-Bender
faces.blurb: A clockwork figure bends one wire into the time with its own two hands: a hook-plaque of finished hours above, a flywheel and an escapement ticking below; each minute it unbends and rebends the wire kink by kink, and the hour gets a little bow.

faces.name: Sand Settler
faces.blurb: Sand grains flow along elegant nodal line paths shaped like digits; smooth minute/hour transitions.

faces.name: Automaton
faces.blurb: Flip-card minutes display: bold art-deco digits flip smoothly upward each minute, mechanical and hypnotic.

faces.name: Klangfigur
faces.blurb: A driven brass plate: the sand on its nodal lines spells the time, and every second a ring sets out from the point that drives it.

faces.name: The Fitter
faces.blurb: A clockwork fitting shop whose numerals are machinery: rods, bent rods and toothed wheels, unscrewed and re-fitted by the machine's own two hands.

faces.name: Harmonograph
faces.blurb: A pendulum plotter: two bobs drag their pens over the page and the time is what they leave, ringing; each minute the changed numeral is reeled back into the pen and inked anew.

faces.name: IMPRINT
faces.blurb: A pin-art board: the minute is the impression a pass pressed into the pins, the hour a pin dial at its centre, the seconds the pass itself.

faces.name: Pop-up
faces.blurb: An open pop-up book: the minute is a card V-folded across the middle and pushed up through a slot in the right page, the hour is a flat die-cut card leaning out of the left page, and on the hour a leaf turns the whole spread over.

faces.name: Loom
faces.blurb: The time woven into cloth: a shuttle throws a pick a second, and every minute a numeral frays out of the weave and is woven back as the next one.

faces.name: Swash
faces.blurb: The tide writes the time in foam on the wet sand and the backwash washes it away; the hour is a spring tide that floods the whole glass.

faces.name: Ants
faces.blurb: The time worn into the ground: pheromone trails the colony walks, and when a minute turns the workers carry the trail to the next numeral.

faces.name: Ebru
faces.blurb: Marbling ink on a tray of water: the numerals are the pattern itself, laid thick, and a needle stirs each one into a bead of ink and out again as the next.

faces.name: Zoetrope
faces.blurb: Two slotted drums on a stand: the time is the loop of film running inside them. The strip slips one frame a minute, a frame an hour, and the drum smears its slats away while it turns.

faces.name: Kinetic
faces.blurb: A field of 153 tiny clocks: locked hands draw the time, idle hands swing as a pendulum wave that falls into unison at :00, when a whirlpool lays down the new minute.

faces.name: Shadow
faces.blurb: A spotlight shines through four glass globes of tangled wire, and only their shadows tell the time; each minute a globe whirls on its thread and its shadow rakes out and snaps into the new digit; each hour they drop and are hauled back up.

faces.name: Chladni
faces.blurb: A bowed Chladni plate: sand on its nodal lines is the time. On the minute the bow changes and the sweep shatters it through real Chladni figures into the next; a fortissimo glissando on the hour.

faces.name: Automaton
faces.blurb: A clockwork frog in round glasses runs a drop forge: all minute it winds the hammer up hand over hand, then stomps the pedal; the iron minute buckles flat and springs up re-bent as the next. On the hour both hammers fall.

faces.name: Blackhole
faces.blurb: The time beside a black hole: lensed digits and a streaming disc; a changing digit is swallowed and re-emitted by the jets, and on the hour the hole eats the time, collapses and explodes.

faces.name: Warp
faces.blurb: The time adrift among streaming stars; every minute the ship jumps to lightspeed and the new time flies in from the vanishing point; the hour goes through a hyperspace tunnel to a planet.

faces.name: Shatter
faces.blurb: Cut-glass digits on a mirror floor: each minute the changing digit cracks, bursts into tumbling 3D shards that bounce on the floor, and rewinds as the new one; bullet time on the hour.

faces.name: Origami
faces.blurb: Paper digits that fold: each minute the changing digit folds itself up crease by crease into a square, somersaults, and unfolds into the next; on the hour the paper becomes a crane.

faces.name: Smoke
faces.blurb: The time in incense smoke: braided wisps that fray and curl; a changing digit billows away and the ember draws the new one in a twisting ribbon; on the hour a smoke ring rolls through.

faces.name: Burn
faces.blurb: The time printed on a sheet of paper, and set alight: a changing numeral smoulders, catches and burns out to the next sheet; on the hour the page goes up in flames and a fresh one drops in.

faces.name: Ferrofluid
faces.blurb: The time in black magnetic liquid on a backlit plate, bristling with spikes; on the minute the magnet lets go, the digit slumps into a puddle and runs along the next coil, and on the hour all of it climbs a spinning spiral.

faces.name: Magnet
faces.blurb: Iron filings comb themselves along stencil digits cut from strip magnets; on the minute the magnets unzip, swarm and zip up as the new digit, and compasses swing; on the hour a big bar magnet sweeps the paper clean.

faces.name: Murmuration
faces.blurb: Starlings at dusk hold the time over a reed bed; each minute the changing digit lifts into a vast swirling murmuration that funnels down as the new one. On the hour a falcon stoops through the flock.

faces.name: Fireflies
faces.blurb: A summer meadow at night; the time is fireflies in formation. Each minute the changing digit unravels, the meadow syncs in waves of flashes and the new digit lights in one bloom. On the hour a jar catches them all and lets them go.

faces.name: Life
faces.blurb: Conway's Game of Life: a spaceship strikes the minute, it boils into chaos, and the chaos un-evolves into the new time; on the hour the colon becomes an R-pentomino.

faces.name: Matrix
faces.blurb: The digital rain: the time is where the code has frozen; on the minute a digit crumbles into rain and the new one is decoded column by column.

faces.name: Ripple
faces.blurb: Stone digits on a pond bed, seen through moving water with real caustics: a raindrop splashes each changing digit away in silt; a koi or a summer shower on the hour.

faces.name: Snow Globe
faces.blurb: The time moulded from snow in a glass globe, a snowman for a colon: a shake lifts the changing digit into a swirling column and it resettles as the new one; a spin and a blizzard on the hour.

faces.name: Glitch
faces.blurb: A VHS tape coming apart: scanlined techno digits pixel-sorted, torn and rolled on the start line into the next minute; a channel change, power cycle and reboot on the hour.

faces.name: Demoscene
faces.blurb: An Amiga cracktro that tells the time: copper bars, starfield, sine scroller, bouncing chrome digits; each minute a dot-sphere morph, a rotozoomer or a twister; the Boing ball on the hour.

faces.name: Kaleidoscope
faces.blurb: Cut-glass digits before a turning N-fold kaleidoscope; on the minute the tube turns, old facets spiral into the mandala and the new digit unfolds from a rosette of its reflections; on the hour the symmetry changes.

faces.name: Spectrum
faces.blurb: A hi-fi spectrum analyser whose bars stand in the shape of the time; every minute the track builds and drops and the new digits spring out of the floor; on the hour a pair of VU meters slams.

faces.name: Tesla
faces.blurb: A Tesla coil writes the time in braided plasma: on the minute it charges, blasts the old digit with lightning and arc-welds the new one; a Jacob's ladder on the hour.

faces.name: Cube
faces.blurb: Four puzzle cubes in real 3D: on the minute a cube is picked up and its slices twist the new digit round; on the hour the row whirls round like a carousel.

faces.name: F-91W
faces.blurb: The Casio F-91W, segment for segment: its LCD glows on black with ghost segments and slow liquid crystal; the micro-light comes on at every minute, the time signal beeps on the hour.

faces.name: Game & Watch
faces.blurb: Star Pond, an original Game & Watch: a frog in glasses nets falling stars on fixed LCD poses with ghost segments; the minute star lands on :00, a comet on the hour.

faces.name: Tourbillon
faces.blurb: A haute-horlogerie movement: a one-minute tourbillon as the seconds, a 4 Hz balance, a jumping minute and a sonnerie that strikes the hours.

faces.name: Ressence
faces.blurb: After the Ressence Type 1: no hands, the whole dial turns once an hour and its satellites orbit upright.

faces.name: Urwerk
faces.blurb: Wandering hours after URWERK: cubes on a carousel ride a 0-60 arc; the hour is a carousel spin.

faces.name: Contour
faces.blurb: Numerals of a variable typeface hug the edge; the hour swells to black, a wave of weight follows the seconds.

faces.name: Scope
faces.blurb: A scope clock: one electron beam writes the time on glowing phosphor; Lissajous knots on the minute, a tube switch-off and an analog dial on the hour.

faces.name: Radar
faces.blurb: A PPI radar scope: the time is four storm cells the sweep repaints; on the minute a swarm of tracks re-forms it.

faces.name: Luna
faces.blurb: Tonight's real moon, maria and all, beside Didone numerals; a meteor rewrites each minute, the hour runs a whole lunation.

faces.name: Jellyfish
faces.blurb: Sea nettles row through black water behind digits of living light; each minute a flash rewrites them, each hour a bloom rises.

faces.name: Hanzi
faces.blurb: A Chinese word clock: 现在是下午三点二十五分 lit on a grid of fifty characters; ink bleeds and gathers on the minute, a seal stamps the hour.

faces.name: Typewriter
faces.blurb: 128x32: every minute a typewriter types the time, then throws the carriage back; a fresh sheet on the hour.

faces.name: Nixie
faces.blurb: Four IN-14 Nixie tubes: wire numerals stacked in the glass, a glow behind the honeycomb anode, and the anti-poisoning roll on the hour.

faces.name: Skyline
faces.blurb: Lujiazui across the Huangpu: the time is lit office windows on four towers, the Pearl is the colon; real sun and moon, fireworks on the hour.

faces.name: Pac-Man
faces.blurb: The time in pellets on the arcade maze: Pac-Man eats the old minute with the ghosts on his tail; on the hour, a power pellet, and he eats them.

faces.name: Tamagotchi
faces.blurb: Mochitchi, a rice-cake pet on a P1-style dot matrix, lives the real day: meals, naps, poops and a flush, a jab when ill, lights out at night.

faces.name: Sand
faces.blurb: Digits heaped from grains of sand: a changing digit drains through the floor, a hopper pours the new one; a storm on the hour; the colon is an hourglass.

faces.name: Marble
faces.blurb: A rolling ball clock: a lift brings up a steel ball each minute; full rails tip, balls cascade home, and at 1:00 everything empties.

faces.name: Fibonacci
faces.blurb: Chrétien's Fibonacci clock as a Mondrian: hours solid, minutes hatched, both dotted; it repaints every minute and rehangs mirrored every hour.

faces.name: Domino
faces.blurb: HH:MM set up in standing dominoes seen from above; a robot lays the seconds, then knocks the minute down.

faces.name: Neon
faces.blurb: A bar-window neon sign: bent-glass digits that sputter out and strike on the minute.

faces.name: Numberfolk
faces.blurb: The digits are little characters: they blink, glance, wave goodbye and arrive in style.

faces.name: Truchet
faces.blurb: A tile typeface in a turning Truchet field: at the minute the tiles lift, spin and re-form the new digit.

faces.name: Mercury
faces.blurb: Liquid chrome digits: they bead up, run into a pool and climb out as the new minute; drips fall and splash.

faces.name: Brush
faces.blurb: Numerals written with an ink brush: pressure, belly, flying white; washed out and rewritten live each minute.

faces.name: Op Art
faces.blurb: Riley lines: the digits are where the waves go calm; each minute a ripple dissolves them and develops the next.

faces.name: Extrude
faces.blurb: Ray-cast chrome title type over a synthwave grid; digits spin on their axis at the minute, a wave of 360s on the hour.

faces.name: Frog
faces.blurb: The rainbow frog in glasses watches a fly all minute, and catches it at :58.

faces.name: Kit-Cat
faces.blurb: The Kit-Cat Klock: eyes and tail tick side to side once a second.

faces.name: Invaders
faces.blurb: The time is the attack wave: the cannon shoots the old minute apart and a mystery ship drops the new one in.

faces.name: Dino
faces.blurb: The Chrome T-Rex runs the minutes: a pterodactyl drops the new digit, the old one falls on the track and gets jumped.

faces.name: Tetris
faces.blurb: HH:MM stacked from real tetrominoes: old digits line-clear, new ones are dropped in piece by piece.

faces.name: Flip
faces.blurb: Split-flap cards in perspective: flaps fall, shade and bounce; the board riffles on the hour.

faces.name: Watch
faces.blurb: An analog watch: baton hands, sweeping seconds, day-date and the real moon phase.

faces.name: Aquarium
faces.blurb: A fish tank: the time is rocks on the sand, and at the minute a school swirls and rebuilds it.

faces.name: Reel
faces.blurb: 128x32: the next minute waits in the hidden half of RAM, then the face rolls up to it.

faces.name: Tape
faces.blurb: 128x32: a ruler of the whole day slides under a hairline that drops from the colon.

faces.name: Classic
faces.blurb: The default font at size 2, centred. What everyone builds first.

faces.name: Specimen
faces.blurb: The kit's type: vector digits, segments, 3x5 and 5x7.

halls.title: Colour TFT
halls.about: Sixteen-bit colour on a glass about 22 mm wide, sent over SPI. The glass is drawn with its colour stripes, backlight and the lag of the liquid crystal.

faces.name: Night Night
faces.blurb: The owner's puppy and panda asleep on their own quilted bed: the puppy dreams the hour in bones, the panda the minutes in bamboo; they steal the blanket, snore, munch and roll over.

faces.name: Balloon Rally
faces.blurb: The floppy puppy (hours) and the shaggy panda (minutes) keep a red balloon up between them, holding their foil number balloons; each minute the panda swats and loses the changing ones, and each hour the puppy floats off with its own and skydives back with the new.

faces.name: Running Stitch
faces.blurb: The owner's floppy puppy and shaggy panda on a grey quilt: the puppy tugs out the old minute's stitches, the panda's needle sews the new one with the same thread.

faces.name: Claw Machine
faces.blurb: The puppy rides the claw, swapping plush numerals in the pit around the panda; on the hour it grabs the panda and lets her slip.

faces.name: DollPet
faces.blurb: The two plush dolls as virtual pets on an egg keychain: the floppy puppy bonks the dot-matrix clock and the loose dots hop back as the new minute.

faces.name: Laundry Day
faces.blurb: The puppy and the panda go round in the wash; each new numeral is flung out of the drum and pegged up wet to dry.

faces.name: Soroban
faces.blurb: A soroban on washi counts the seconds itself, flicked by a fingertip seen only as its shadow; carries ripple left along the bar. Rods read HH | MM | SS: the top bead is 5, each lower bead 1, when touching the bar.

faces.name: Othello
faces.blurb: The time in discs on a Reversi board that changes hands every minute: a disc is flicked, lands at :00 and the cascade flips everything but the new time; the lamp circling the board is the second hand.

faces.name: Night Rink
faces.blurb: Skaters cut the time into floodlit ice as blade tracings; a resurfacer shaves each changing numeral away.

faces.name: Incense Seal
faces.blurb: The hour pressed in incense powder, folded 60 times: an ember crosses one fold a minute and leaves ash.

faces.name: Su Song
faces.blurb: Su Song's 1092 water-driven clock tower as a Song silk painting: the escapement lurches the wheel every 5 s; jacks in the doors hold the hour and minute.

faces.name: Ouija
faces.blurb: A planchette spells the time by candlelight; each figure rises from its window as ectoplasm and hangs over the board until GOOD BYE.

faces.name: Tarot
faces.blurb: A Marseille tarot reading by candlelight: hour arcanum, then the minute as two pip cards; a hand deals each change, a ribbon spread every hour.

faces.name: Outlook Good
faces.blurb: A Magic 8-Ball window: the icosahedral die rolls a new face onto the glass each minute and its raised type gives the time; on the hour it is shaken, says "ask again later", and is shaken again.

faces.name: Vitals
faces.blurb: A bedside monitor: the heart beats at 60 and each beat writes a digit into the ECG; the minute turn is a dropped beat.

faces.name: Karesansui
faces.blurb: A raked dry garden from above, lit by the real sun: the time is the gravel left smooth; a monk rakes each minute out and the next one in.

faces.name: Claymation
faces.blurb: One lump of plasticine, re-sculpted at 12 fps into the hour, then the minutes, then back; thumbprints, boil, a thumb at the hour.

faces.name: Marionette
faces.blurb: Plywood numerals on strings, worked by a puppeteer's hands; at the minute the changing one is flown out and the new one lowered in.

faces.name: Night Train
faces.blurb: The view from a night train in the rain: the hour is a far mountain village, the minutes a hill town, written in their street lamps; minutes turn in tunnels or behind freight trains, hours at a station with railway clocks.

faces.name: Plankton
faces.blurb: Night beach from above: the time is written in wet sand, and every wave that runs over it wakes the plankton in the grooves.

faces.name: Receipt
faces.blurb: A thermal till prints each minute as a sale: TOTAL 10:09, barcode and all; it curls, is torn off at :57 and falls.

faces.name: Fridge
faces.blurb: Magnetic poetry on a fridge door says the time; a hand swaps the words each minute, and at the hour the door is slammed and a child puts the plastic letters back.

faces.name: Two-Blocked
faces.blurb: Through binoculars, a schooner at anchor flies the time in ICS numeral pennants; sailors haul each change down and run it up again, and you pencil it into the signal log.

faces.name: Nature morte à l'heure
faces.blurb: An analytic cubist still life of the time: long planes swing across an oval canvas and each sees the stencil numerals from its own place; they drift apart through the minute and reassemble after it; through the hour facets become pasted papers that show the time flat.

faces.name: Memphis
faces.blurb: An anamorphic Memphis sculpture: striped, dotted and squiggled objects scattered in depth line up into the time from one viewpoint; each minute the camera swings away and the pieces regroup.

faces.name: Lighthouse
faces.blurb: Fl W 5s: a rock light in a gale; each time its beam looks at you the flash burns the time into your eye, and its afterimage floats over the storm through the flight of colours until the next one.

faces.name: Snap
faces.blurb: A baseplate from above: the time in real bricks, and a hand that pulls, turns and presses them into the next minute.

faces.name: Night Shift
faces.blurb: A security monitor wall: each minute a car pulls up to the barrier and the ANPR camera reads its plate, which is the time; the other feeds follow its driver through the building.

faces.name: Long Exposure
faces.blurb: A fairground wheel shot with the shutter open: its spokes are a propeller clock, and the bulbs' light trails write the time across the arch.

faces.name: Vinyl
faces.blurb: A spinning LP under one lamp: the hour and minutes are a hologram cut into the grooves; the arm plays one side an hour and the record turns over at the hour.

faces.name: Gnomon
faces.blurb: A cloud of brass spheres in a sunbeam; only their shadows spell the time, and the sun re-aims every minute.

faces.name: Shufa
faces.blurb: A brush writes the time in Chinese characters down the columns of a handscroll, stroke by stroke in real order; the ink bleeds into the rice paper, a seal is stamped, and each minute the scroll rolls on.

faces.name: Crossword
faces.blurb: A pencil solves a newspaper mini crossword every minute: 1-Across is the hour, the long answer is the minute; the page turns on the hour.

faces.name: Pianola
faces.blurb: The time is punched into a player-piano roll; the keys play it, and the roll rushes through at every minute.

faces.name: Datamosh
faces.blurb: A broken video stream: only the numerals decode right, so the rest of the picture drags their ink away; new minutes are born out of decoder garbage.

faces.name: Isometric
faces.blurb: An impossible floating monument: its numerals are stones scattered at every depth that only line up from this one camera. Each minute the camera swings round, the time falls apart, new stones rise from the clouds and snap into line.

faces.name: Fighter
faces.blurb: Hours versus minutes: every minute a new challenger fights the hour, K.O. at :57; round 59 is the upset.

faces.name: Spell Card
faces.blurb: A danmaku boss fight: the time is a frozen curtain of bullets the ship weaves around; each minute is a spell card that breaks into items at :57.

faces.name: Index of Refraction
faces.blurb: Two snow globes on a window sill hold numerals of glass you cannot see in the water; the snow that sticks to them is the time. Each minute the front one is turned over, shaken and set down, and the new minutes settle out of the blizzard.

faces.name: Rorschach
faces.blurb: Each minute ink is dropped on a card, folded and pressed; the symmetric blot that opens is the time (right wing original, left the mirrored print).

faces.name: Saul Bass
faces.blurb: Every minute is the opening titles of a 1950s film: cut-paper kinetic type in five shots (Vertigo, Psycho, North by Northwest, Anatomy of a Murder, The Man with the Golden Arm), cut on a jazz beat.

faces.name: Synthwave
faces.blurb: An 80s title card on an endless night drive: the hour in live-reflecting chrome, the minutes laser-written in neon script; each hour the title flies over the camera at turbo speed and the route enters a new stage.

faces.name: Kaleidoscope
faces.blurb: The time is glass rods in the cell of a kaleidoscope; at every minute the mirrors close, fold it into a mandala, and open on the new time.

faces.name: Flipbook
faces.blurb: A pencil flipbook riffled by a thumb every ten seconds: the time is hand-drawn on every page, and each numeral hides a doodle (2 a swan, 9 a balloon) that comes out, acts, and at the minute leaves the page.

faces.name: Four Lifts
faces.blurb: A night tower across the street: the time is the floors its four glass lifts stand at. Each minute a passenger rides one floor; 120 windows live their own lives.

faces.name: Rube Goldberg
faces.blurb: A 1930s newspaper cartoon contraption runs once round the panel every minute, a clockwise second hand of marbles, canaries, candles and dominoes, to flip the minute card.

faces.name: Droste
faces.blurb: Howlaround feedback: fall forever through screens inside screens; each new minute climbs out of the vanishing point.

faces.name: Constructivist
faces.blurb: A Rodchenko poster that shouts the time: a red cone of wedge-shaped type pours from a photomontage mouth, and zooms out of the glass at every minute.

faces.name: Viewpoint
faces.blurb: PS1-era low-poly world: the time is stone slabs floating at different depths over a wobbling sea, lined up from one camera position; each minute the camera walks off and it falls apart.

faces.name: Lemmings
faces.blurb: A Lemmings level whose ground is the time: a stream of lemmings walks over brick numerals; each minute diggers or bombers take the old one away and a builder lays the new one, and at the hour the crowd is nuked.

faces.name: Turing
faces.blurb: A living reaction-diffusion skin; the time is where it grows a hotter pigment, a growth front sweeps the seconds.

faces.name: Orrery
faces.blurb: Wandering hours: the world in front of the sun has the hour for continents; where it is in its orbit is the minute.

faces.name: L'Empire des heures
faces.blurb: A Magritte: a day sky over a night street, the time cut out of the day so the night shows through. Each minute the sky cracks and falls into the canal; at night the painting turns over.

faces.name: Desktop
faces.blurb: A tiny 1995 PC keeps the time by hand: the pointer retypes TIME.TXT every minute, each time differently (window trails, screensaver, a crash, Edit > Time/Date), and the hour is a blue screen and a reboot into "Windows 11:00".

faces.name: Lava Lamp
faces.blurb: Four lava lamps on a shelf: the numerals are their wax, which beats, buds and kisses the pool every second, and beads up, floats and re-forms each minute.

faces.name: Glassblower
faces.blurb: The hot shop: the numerals are strands of hot glass on the marver; each minute the old one slumps into a glowing gather and is pulled into the new one.

faces.name: Octopus
faces.blurb: An octopus under a reef ledge holds up the time: each numeral is one of its arms, curled into the digit, suckers on the inside, chromatophore waves pulsing down it; each minute the arm uncoils and recurls into the next digit.

faces.name: Pop-up Book
faces.blurb: A children's pop-up book: the numerals are die-cut cards bobbing on paper springs; each minute the page turns, the old pop-ups fold flat and the new spread opens with the new time rising out of it.

faces.name: Dachshund

faces.name: Bead Maze
faces.blurb: A toddler's bead-maze toy: each numeral is a bent coloured wire with chunky beads that clack along it on the beat; each minute the wire relaxes and is bent into the next digit.

faces.name: Calder
faces.blurb: A Calder mobile: each numeral is a bent wire hung from balanced arms among painted discs; at the minute the wire coils up and unrolls into the next.

faces.name: Taffy
faces.blurb: A candy shop window: the time is four ropes of striped taffy hung on brass hooks, bouncing and swaying on the beat; each minute a pulling pin stretches a digit, folds it into a skein and lays it out as the next.

faces.name: Fogged Glass
faces.blurb: A misted window on a rainy night: the time is finger-written in the condensation, the street's lights sharp through every stroke; drops run, the neon blinks through the colon, the last tram floods the glass at the hour.

faces.name: Ribbon
faces.blurb: A rhythmic gymnastics group writes the time in satin ribbons, creased at the corners; each minute a ribbon winds into a coil and unwinds as the new numeral.

faces.name: Soft Serve
faces.blurb: An ice-cream counter: each numeral is one twisted ribbon of soft serve on a cone or in a sundae boat; it wobbles on the beat, melts at the turn, and the machine pipes the new one.

faces.name: Geoboard
faces.blurb: A classroom geoboard: each numeral is one rubber band stretched over the pegs, strummed every second; at the minute the bands slip off peg by peg and snap onto the new numeral.

faces.name: Origami
faces.blurb: Each numeral is a sheet of two-sided paper folded into the digit; they hop and flap on the beat, and each minute a sheet unfolds flat and refolds, flap after flap, into the next.

faces.name: Slinky
faces.blurb: Four rainbow coil springs on a staircase, each bent into a numeral; a pulse runs every spring each second, and at the minute the changing spring stands up into a Slinky arch and drops into the new digit.

faces.name: Aurora
faces.blurb: The northern lights over a frozen lake: each numeral is an aurora curtain; every minute the changing curtains break up into rays, shoot up, and fall into the new time.

faces.name: Air Dancer
faces.blurb: Four wacky waving tube men outside a car lot, each tube sewn in the shape of a numeral; each minute the old one sags into a heap and the new one whooshes up.

faces.name: Teletext
faces.blurb: Ceefax page 302: the time is the weather, four mosaic clouds raining over a blocky British Isles; the page reloads row by row at the hour.

faces.name: Wayang Kulit
faces.blurb: Wayang kulit: the four numerals are carved leather shadow puppets in dialogue on a lamp-lit screen, pressed to the cloth on every gamelan beat; each minute a puppet withdraws into the lamp, and at the hour the gunungan crosses the screen.

faces.name: Le Chahut
faces.blurb: Seurat's can-can in pure dots: each numeral is a dancer's frilled petticoat, kicking on the beat under the gas globes of the colon; each minute the old dancer skips off and the new one cartwheels in.

faces.name: Boogie-Woogie
faces.blurb: Mondrian's Broadway Boogie Woogie: each numeral is a street plan whose traffic squares hop on a swung boogie beat; the traffic re-routes at the turn, rush hour at the hour.

faces.name: Polo
faces.blurb: A Persian miniature of a royal polo match: each numeral is a horse in the flying gallop with its rider; the minute dissolves into gold dust and gallops back in as the next.

faces.name: Tomb
faces.blurb: A Theban tomb wall under the arch of Nut: each numeral is a living hieroglyph (serpents, reeds, ropes) that slithers, sways and turns on the beat; each minute the paint flakes off and the painter grids, sketches, outlines and colours the new sign.
